title: Jejak Cahaya di Gang Digital
theme: Melalui teknologi inovatif, seorang pengembang menemukan cara merefleksikan emosi diri dan merasakan jejak digital orang lain di kota.

cover.prompt: Neo-Jakarta cityscape at late evening, showcasing soft, colorful neon illuminations glowing across narrow urban passages. Wet city pavement reflects elongated light patterns, creating a mesmerizing visual. The serene atmosphere of a tranquil metropolis, with silent electric vehicles gently gliding through the scene. A distant street food vendor cart emanates subtle steam, hinting at warm aromas. The composition captures the calming contrast of the city's gentle pulse, focusing on environmental details and mood.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading, urban-futuristic aesthetic.

meta.plan_summary: Arka, an app developer, tests his experimental wearable, AuraLens, designed to visualize his emotions. Unexpectedly, it begins to project unknown light patterns, revealing the collective emotional traces of others in Neo-Jakarta's narrow alleys. Arka realizes this isn't a bug but a feature, connecting him to the city's hidden emotional layer, finding peace and deeper empathy through this unique connection.
meta.target_emotion: Contemplation, tranquility, empathy, and a sense of profound connection.
